findings.body: The scan covers only three documentation files, leaving current new-Forge docs unchecked. For example, `docs/specs/fde-discovery.md:4` marks that spec confirmed, and lines 18–27 explicitly describe the new Forge. Adding a plugin reference there would leave this test passing. `docs/archive.md:31–33` also identifies retained documentation beyond this list. Extend the scan to cover the new Forge documentation, with explicit exclusions for legacy material, so the required item-13 guard detects references outside the guide’s uninstall section.
